name: SubNav
description: `SubNav` is a horizontal secondary navigation bar composed from `SubNav.Links` and `SubNav.Link`.

props.name: actions
props.description: Controls shown at the end of the bar, beside the links.

props.name: align
props.description: Aligns the links to the end of the bar.

props.name: full
props.description: Stretches the bar to fill the width of its container.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the navigation region.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render. Use a non-anchor element when the link is handled by a router.

props.name: selected
props.description: Marks the link as the current page.
